description: This header file defines external API functions for the Atom Table Object in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the Atom Table Object, along with licensing and module information.

methods.name: AnscCreateAtomTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Atom Table Object with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscAtoCreate
methods.description: Creates the Atom Table Object with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscAtoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the Atom Table Object.

methods.name: AnscAtoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Atom Table Object.
